title: Nice if no defects
text: I've gotten Amazon gift cards in tins for years because they make the gift seem much nicer.  I'm generally happy with them, but I really don't like that you can't see the value.  If you get multiple cards in the same tin with different values, there's no easy way to tell which is which.  Once I got one on which the paint was so scuffed up I didn't feel comfortable giving it as a gift, but Amazon wasn't willing to replace the tin.  I'm guessing the tins are all prefilled with cards, so they couldn't do that, but it was disappointing.  Fortunately, shipping is free, and I had a few more days before I needed to give the card, so I was able to order a second one and use the original gift card myself.
